steps.title: Симметрия, UNION, окна
steps.content:
## Advanced Join

- Self-join для симметричных пар.
- **`UNION`** vs **`UNION ALL`** для списков title.
- Накопительная сумма: **`SUM(...) OVER (ORDER BY …)`**.

content.description:
Пары `(task_id, start_day, end_day)` задач, которые **перекрываются по дням** (один и тот же `day` в `task_start` и `task_end`). Сортировка по `task_id`, `start_day`.

[HackerRank: SQL Project Planning](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/sql-project-planning/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE task_start(task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, start_day INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(task_id, start_day));
CREATE TABLE task_end(task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, end_day INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(task_id, end_day));
content.starterCode: SELECT s.task_id, s.start_day, e.end_day FROM task_start s JOIN task_end e ON s.task_id = e.task_id ORDER BY s.task_id, s.start_day;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT DISTINCT s.task_id, s.start_day, e.end_day
FROM task_start s
JOIN task_end e ON s.task_id = e.task_id
WHERE s.start_day = e.end_day
ORDER BY s.task_id, s.start_day;

content.description:
Студенты из `Students`, **не** попавшие в `Placements`. Верните `id`, `name`. Сортировка по `id`.

[HackerRank: Placements](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/placements/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Students(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Placements(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT S.id, S.name FROM Students S JOIN Placements P ON S.id = P.student_id ORDER BY S.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT S.id, S.name FROM Students S LEFT JOIN Placements P ON S.id = P.student_id WHERE P.student_id IS NULL ORDER BY S.id;

content.description:
Пары `(id, f_id)` из `Functions`, для которых существует `(f_id, id)` и `id < f_id`. Сортировка по `id`.

[HackerRank: Symmetric Pairs](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/symmetric-pairs/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Functions(id INTEGER NOT NULL, f_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id, f_id));
content.starterCode: SELECT id, f_id FROM Functions ORDER BY id;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT f1.id, f1.f_id
FROM Functions f1
JOIN Functions f2 ON f1.id = f2.f_id AND f1.f_id = f2.id
WHERE f1.id < f1.f_id
ORDER BY f1.id;

content.description:
**Различные** названия должностей (`title`) из `Companies` и `Challenges` (объединение). Сортировка по `title`.

[HackerRank: Interviews](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/interviews/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Companies(company_code INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, founder TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Challenges(challenge_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_code INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT title FROM Companies UNION ALL SELECT title FROM Challenges ORDER BY title;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT DISTINCT title FROM Companies
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT title FROM Challenges
ORDER BY title;

content.description:
По каждому `contest_id`: `contest_date`, `total_submissions`, **накопительная** сумма `total_submissions` (`running_total`). Сортировка по `contest_date`.

[HackerRank: 15 Days of Learning SQL](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/15-days-of-learning-sql/problem)
content.starterCode: SELECT C.contest_id, C.start_date, COUNT(S.submission_id) FROM Contests C JOIN Challenges CH ON C.contest_id = CH.contest_id JOIN Submissions S ON CH.challenge_id = S.challenge_id GROUP BY C.contest_id ORDER BY C.start_date;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT C.contest_id, C.start_date AS contest_date, COUNT(S.submission_id) AS total_submissions
  FROM Contests C
  JOIN Challenges CH ON C.contest_id = CH.contest_id
  JOIN Submissions S ON CH.challenge_id = S.challenge_id
  GROUP BY C.contest_id, C.start_date
)
SELECT contest_id, contest_date, total_submissions,
  SUM(total_submissions) OVER (ORDER BY contest_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
FROM daily
ORDER BY contest_date;

content.question: Как получить running total по дате?
options: SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
